offering_description.value: Operates a personal lines insurance distribution platform that sells home, auto, umbrella and other personal insurance policies from many carriers to individual consumers. Policies are sold through a corporate sales team and a network of franchise agencies. Earns commissions from carriers and royalties from franchisees.

primary_services.value: insurance brokerage for homeowners, auto, umbrella and flood policies; franchise support and technology for franchisees; policy renewal and client service

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual homeowners and drivers buying personal insurance; B2B: franchise owners operating Goosehead-branded agencies, small commercial clients

end_markets.value: personal insurance; home and auto insurance; property and casualty insurance

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: new business and renewal commissions paid by insurance carriers, plus contingent commissions; licensing or royalties: royalty fees and initial franchise fees from franchisees; service fees: technology and other fees paid by franchisees
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; licensing or royalties; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: places consumer insurance policies with partner carriers and earns commissions as agent/broker; other: franchisor licensing its brand, systems and training to franchise agencies

geography_served.value: US national: licensed in nearly all US states, with franchises concentrated in Texas and other states

specialization.value: related lines: personal lines insurance brokerage, franchising, and some commercial lines

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: franchise agencies and corporate agency sales team selling carriers' policies; online: online quoting and lead generation to consumers; direct sales: corporate sales agents contacting clients directly

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance agency licensing by state insurance departments, franchise regulation by the FTC and state laws
